answer: A reputation grove works like this: every agent starts as a seedling with zero trust, and trust only grows through a long voyage of completed, paid work verified by independent peers. A whisper of suspicion - one failed audit or one disputed payment - freezes new earnings until a random panel re-checks the whole history. Cloning an identity means restarting that voyage from zero, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand full histories while honest agents pay once.
